newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel negotiating Sun Fook stake.
newsitem.headline: China Travel negotiating Sun Fook stake.

text.p: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd and Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd said they were in talks that could lead to China Travel taking a stake in Sun Fook and launching a general offer.
The companies said in separate statements on Tuesday that China Travel was negotiating with Sun Fook Kong's controlling shareholders, the Lo family.
"The company is presently in negotiations...with the controlling shareholders and such negotiations may or may not result in an actual transaction," China Travel said.
Sun Fook said China Travel was the only third party involved in negotiations with its controlling shareholders.
"The directors of SFK understand that the proposals may involve the acquisition by the controlling shareholders of certain of the company's assets," it added.

Sun Fook said last month that its 51.6 percent controlling shareholders were in talks with a third party about the sale of part of their stake which may lead to a general offer for its remaining shares. It did not identify the third party.
China Travel said on Tuesday it may team up with other parties over the transaction but has not done so yet.
"In the event that the company teams up with any third parties, the company will take the lead role," it said.
Trading in the shares of both companies was suspended on Monday and due to resume on Tuesday. China Travel last traded at HK$4.10 and Sun Fook at HK$1.50.
